text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days before the Mainichi Hai, Yaeno Muteki asks me who I think she should keep an eye on during the race. My answer is Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is a racer from Kasamatsu whose impressive talent has garnered a lot of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Mainichi Hai. Yaeno Muteki finds herself unsettled by Oguri Cap's seeming lack of competitive driving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she doesn't let that distract her. Yaeno Muteki rallies her spirit and focuses her attention on the race!
